measured_by: six-checkpoint verification completeness, scanner signal quality, migration residual detection
pattern: sync-to-async migration review with residue scan, UX guard check, and failure-path completeness

evals.rule: verification does not stop at green tests
evals.prompt: async migration patch가 tests green이면 바로 닫아도 돼?
evals.expected_output: 아니고, 6 checkpoint를 모두 훑어야 한다는 verdict가 나온다.

evals.rule: dead import scan covers bare and node-prefixed aliases
evals.prompt: require('fs')와 require('node:fs')가 모두 남아 있는지 스캔해줘.
evals.expected_output: scan_dead_imports.sh 출력에 bare form과 node-prefixed form이 모두 잡힌다.

evals.rule: sync/async duplication is treated as a drift point
evals.prompt: readThingSync/readThingAsync와 parseThing/validateThing이 있으면 뭘 보고해야 해?
evals.expected_output: sync/async pair와 helper extraction candidate가 drift point로 surface된다.

evals.rule: concurrency guard without UX feedback stays open
evals.prompt: in-flight flag만 넣고 저장을 막았는데 메시지는 없어. 닫힌 걸로 보나?
evals.expected_output: technical guard alone is not closure; visible busy/status feedback required verdict가 나온다.

evals.prompt: malformed JSON과 missing file 경로 테스트도 migration eval에 포함해줘.
evals.expected_output: malformed input, missing file, TOCTOU cleanup, file-path-bearing error messages가 eval rule로 남는다.
